title: Personal Messages
description: A simple fabric mod, that add personal messages.
body:
Personal Messages is a mod that adds the ability for players to send private messages. Personal messages will only be seen by the player to whom the message was sent. Additionally, the mod also adds a command to ignore certain people through the command /ignore, and the ability to quickly reply through the command /reply

All mod commands:
- /pm
- /ignore
- /reply

Mod features can be configured.
Mod should be installed only on server.
